THE WORLD IS YOUR PLAYGROUND

Find it. Pin it.
See how close.

Each game draws five different places. Every round is worth up to 100 points, for a maximum of 500.

  • Cities: find the named city. Pins within 15 km earn 100 points.
  • Countries: find the named country. Any point inside its mapped border earns 100 points.
  • Flags: identify the flag, then pin its country. Country borders are visible.

Misses lose points gradually with distance. Country and flag misses use the closest border, not the capital.

North always stays up. Drag with one finger or your mouse; pinch or scroll to zoom. Tap or click to move your pin, then lock it in. With the globe focused, use arrow keys, +/−, and Space to pin the center.

A little map knowledge.

All maps, flags, and game code are embedded in this file. No connection or account is needed.

Boundaries use Natural Earth's 1:50m world map through World Atlas. Borders are approximate and reflect the dataset; disputed areas and tiny islands may differ from other maps.

Globe: D3 (ISC), TopoJSON (ISC), and Versor (ISC). Map: Natural Earth (public domain). Flags: flag-icons (MIT).

Scoring: 100 within 15 km of a city or inside a country; otherwise 99 × exp(−distance / 2,000), rounded. For cities, the first 15 km are subtracted. Distance is in kilometres.
